title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on Matthew 11: John's question from prison, what Jesus said about John, the woes on the cities and the invitation to find rest.

questions.text: What did John's disciples ask Jesus when John heard in prison about his works?
questions.explanation: They asked whether he was the one who comes, or whether they should look for another.

answers.text: Whether he would free John from prison
Whether he was the one who comes
Whether he was Elijah the prophet
When the Kingdom of Heaven would come

questions.text: What did Jesus say happens to the poor?
questions.explanation: Among the things they hear and see, Jesus named that the poor have good news preached to them.

answers.text: Good news is preached to them

questions.text: Where did Jesus say those who wear soft clothing are?
questions.explanation: He said that those who wear soft clothing are in kings' houses.

questions.text: What did Jesus say about John compared with those born of women?
questions.explanation: He said that among those born of women no one greater than John the Baptizer has arisen.

answers.text: He was the least of the prophets
He was equal to Elijah's servant
No one greater than John had arisen
He was greater than the Kingdom of Heaven

questions.text: To what did Jesus compare this generation?
questions.explanation: He compared this generation to children sitting in the marketplaces who call to their companions.

answers.text: A reed shaken by the wind

questions.text: What did people say about John, who came neither eating nor drinking?
questions.explanation: Because John came neither eating nor drinking, they said: He has a demon.

answers.text: He is a glutton and a drunkard
He is a servant of the king
He is a reed in the wind

questions.text: On which two cities did Jesus pronounce woe, saying Tyre and Sidon would have repented?
questions.explanation: He said: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For Tyre and Sidon would have repented had such works been done in them.

questions.text: What did Jesus say would happen to Capernaum, which was exalted to heaven?
questions.explanation: He said that Capernaum, exalted to heaven, would go down to Hades.

answers.text: It would be left in ashes
It would go down to Hades

questions.text: To whom did Jesus say the Father had revealed these things?
questions.explanation: He thanked the Father for hiding these things from the wise and understanding and revealing them to infants.

questions.text: What did Jesus say about his yoke and his burden?
questions.explanation: He said his yoke is easy and his burden is light.

answers.text: His yoke is heavy but his reward is great
His burden must be carried alone
His yoke is for the wise only
His yoke is easy and his burden is light
